text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. This report recommends a u-turn prohibition on Timberbank Boulevard, between Carondale Crescent (east intersection) and Chaldean Street. Prohibiting u-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Timberbank Boulevard located adjacent to Timberbank Junior Public School.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited east/westbound and north/southbound u-turn movements at all times on Timberbank Boulevard, between Carondale Crescent (east intersection) and Chaldean Street.
